lines.zh: 我走不了，只是看起来像在走。
lines.en: I can't walk. I only look as if I might.

lines.zh: 我被人搬过一段，脚没动。
lines.en: Someone carried me a stretch. My feet didn't move.

lines.zh: 我的姿势是固定的，改不了。
lines.en: My pose is fixed. I can't change it.

lines.zh: 我歪了一点，是因为地板斜。
lines.en: I lean a little because the floor slopes.

lines.zh: 我坐在这里，看着人走来走去。
lines.en: I sit here watching people come and go.

lines.zh: 我的腿被摆成这个角度，久了。
lines.en: My legs were set at this angle long ago.

lines.zh: 如果有风，我身上的绒毛会动。
lines.en: If there's a breeze, my fluff moves.

lines.zh: 我在这张椅子上坐了几年。
lines.en: I've sat in this chair for years.

lines.zh: 我的影子每天都会走一遍。
lines.en: My shadow makes a round every day.

lines.zh: 有人挪我一下，我就换个方向。
lines.en: Someone nudges me and I face a new way.

lines.zh: 我不离开这个角落。
lines.en: I don't leave this corner.

lines.zh: 布做的东西，走不动的。
lines.en: Things made of cloth don't walk.

lines.zh: 我坐着，从早到晚都这样。
lines.en: I sit. Morning to night, like this.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛盯着门，一直没眨。
lines.en: My eyes hold the door and never blink.

lines.zh: 灰尘落在我肩上，积成一层。
lines.en: Dust settles on my shoulder in a layer.

lines.zh: 我身上有一根线松了。
lines.en: One thread on me has come loose.

lines.zh: 屋里很安静，只有钟在走。
lines.en: The room is quiet but for the clock.

lines.zh: 我是一只摆件，别期待太多。
lines.en: I'm a display piece. Don't expect much.

lines.zh: 有人从我身边走过，没看我。
lines.en: Someone passes and doesn't look at me.

lines.zh: 我的嘴角是缝死的。
lines.en: My mouth corners are stitched shut.

lines.zh: 我在等有人搬动我。
lines.en: I'm waiting for someone to move me.

lines.zh: 这张椅子有点硬，我无所谓。
lines.en: This chair is hard. I don't mind.

lines.zh: 灯泡在我头上闪，我不动。
lines.en: The bulb flickers above me. I don't move.

lines.zh: 我的影子比我先老。
lines.en: My shadow has aged before I did.

lines.zh: 窗外的光移过来，又走了。
lines.en: The window light crosses me and leaves.

lines.zh: 我身上有股旧棉花的味道。
lines.en: I smell of old cotton.

lines.zh: 你盯着我看，我也盯着你。
lines.en: You stare at me. I stare back.

lines.zh: 我坐着，你站着，我们差不多高。
lines.en: I sit, you stand. We're near the same height.

lines.zh: 别指望我站起来打招呼。
lines.en: Don't expect me to stand and greet you.

lines.zh: 你手伸过来，我动不了，但记着。
lines.en: You reach out. I can't move, and I'll remember.

lines.zh: 我是这间屋子的摆设之一。
lines.en: I'm one of this room's ornaments.

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住了我的腿。
lines.en: Your shadow covers my legs.

lines.zh: 我坐在这里，看得比你想的多。
lines.en: Sitting here, I see more than you'd think.

lines.zh: 你为什么不坐下？这里有椅子。
lines.en: Why not sit? There's a chair.

lines.zh: 我笑是因为我的脸就这样。
lines.en: I'm smiling because my face is made that way.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛反光，你看见了吧。
lines.en: My eyes catch the light. You saw.

lines.zh: 你走得越近，我越像活的。
lines.en: The closer you come, the more alive I look.

lines.zh: 我看不出你在想什么。
lines.en: I can't tell what you're thinking.

lines.zh: 这间屋子以前有很多人。
lines.en: This room used to hold a lot of people.

lines.zh: 你的靴子比我整个脚还大。
lines.en: Your boot is bigger than my whole foot.

lines.zh: 别把东西放在我腿上。
lines.en: Don't put things on my lap.

lines.zh: 我就坐在这儿，很安静。
lines.en: I'll just sit here. Quietly.

lines.zh: 我坐在这把椅子上，腿够不到地。
lines.en: I sit in this chair and my legs do not reach the floor.

lines.zh: 我们这样对着看，是你的主意。
lines.en: Facing each other like this was your idea.

lines.zh: 我的棉花被撞出来了。
lines.en: My stuffing's knocked loose.

lines.zh: 这一下让我更歪了。
lines.en: That left me more crooked.

lines.zh: 我不疼，但我记住了角度。
lines.en: I don't hurt, but I remember the angle.

lines.zh: 线又开了一根。
lines.en: Another thread has come undone.

lines.zh: 我的脚在地板上滑了一下。
lines.en: My foot slid on the floor.

lines.zh: 你打歪了我的头，我看着旁边了。
lines.en: You turned my head; I'm facing sideways now.

lines.zh: 绒毛上多了个口子。
lines.en: There's a new tear in my plush.

lines.zh: 我歪着，还是没倒下去。
lines.en: I'm tilted, and still upright.

lines.zh: 我身上的旧灰全都扬起来了。
lines.en: All the old dust on me lifts.

lines.zh: 打我这样的东西，手会疼的。
lines.en: Hitting something like me will hurt your hand.

lines.zh: 你把那个举到我面前，也没用。
lines.en: Holding it up to me changes nothing.

lines.zh: 我动不了，拿不到。
lines.en: I can't move. I can't take it.

lines.zh: 我是布做的，不吃东西。
lines.en: I'm made of cloth. I don't eat.

lines.zh: 你把东西放在我手上吧。
lines.en: You could set it in my hand.

lines.zh: 那味道我不熟悉。
lines.en: That smell I don't know.

lines.zh: 我盯着看，也仅仅是看着。
lines.en: I look at it. Only look.

lines.zh: 如果我能伸手，我会伸。
lines.en: If I could reach, I would.

lines.zh: 这点诱惑，对摆件没用。
lines.en: Such temptation does nothing for ornaments.

lines.zh: 你举了很久，手会酸。
lines.en: You've held it a long while. Your arm will ache.

lines.zh: 放我脚边，也许我明天会捡。
lines.en: Leave it at my feet. Maybe I'll pick it up tomorrow.

lines.zh: 你碰到我，我晃了一下，没倒。
lines.en: You bump me, I rock, and don't fall.

lines.zh: 我比看起来重，里面填得实。
lines.en: I'm heavier than I look. Stuffed tight.

lines.zh: 你把我的坐姿碰歪了。
lines.en: You knocked my sitting pose crooked.

lines.zh: 我挡了你的路，抱歉。
lines.en: I'm in your way. Sorry.

lines.zh: 碰撞让我身上的灰都飞起来。
lines.en: The bump sends dust off me.

lines.zh: 我的手臂被撞得转了个向。
lines.en: My arm got knocked into a new angle.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的脚了，就在那儿。
lines.en: You stepped on my foot. Right there.

lines.zh: 我不让，因为我也让不了。
lines.en: I don't move aside, because I can't.

lines.zh: 你贴着我过去，很小心。
lines.en: You squeeze past. Carefully.

lines.zh: 我往旁边倒了一寸，坐回来。
lines.en: I lean an inch and settle back.

lines.zh: 我是一块布和一些棉花。
lines.en: I'm cloth and stuffing.

lines.zh: 这个请求，我办不到。
lines.en: I can't do that request.

lines.zh: 请不要在我身上倚靠。
lines.en: Please don't lean on me like that.

lines.zh: 我坐着，就是这么个姿势。
lines.en: I sit. That's the whole pose.

lines.zh: 我的关节被钉死了。
lines.en: My joints are pinned shut.

lines.zh: 你要说的话，可以对着我说。
lines.en: Say what you like. To my face.

lines.zh: 这屋子里的规矩，我不清楚。
lines.en: The rules of this house aren't clear to me.

lines.zh: 我不该被碰。
lines.en: I shouldn't be touched.

lines.zh: 我更愿意做一个安静的摆设。
lines.en: I'd rather be a quiet ornament.

lines.zh: 你走开吧，我还想坐着。
lines.en: Go away. I'd like to keep sitting.

lines.zh: 还是不能捡，我试过了。
lines.en: Still can't pick it up. I've tried.

lines.zh: 东西就在我脚边，够不到。
lines.en: It's right at my feet, out of reach.

lines.zh: 我盯着它，一点办法也没有。
lines.en: I stare at it. Nothing to be done.

lines.zh: 要是有人帮我捡就好了。
lines.en: Wish someone would pick it up for me.

lines.zh: 我用眼睛把东西挪了三寸。
lines.en: I move it three inches with my eyes.

lines.zh: 那枚扣子滚到我的椅子上。
lines.en: That button rolled against my chair.

lines.zh: 我对它没有兴趣，只是看着。
lines.en: I don't want it. I just look.

lines.zh: 我身上什么也放不住。
lines.en: I can't hold anything on me.

lines.zh: 地上的东西，会一直在地上。
lines.en: Things on the floor stay on the floor.

lines.zh: 如果我能低头，我早捡了。
lines.en: If I could bend, I'd have taken it.

lines.zh: 我在看着你，从你进门开始。
lines.en: I've watched you since you came in.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛就朝着那个方向。
lines.en: My eyes point that way already.

lines.zh: 你要动手的话，我拦不了。
lines.en: If you mean to act, I can't stop you.

lines.zh: 我坐在这儿，是一个记号。
lines.en: Sitting here, I'm a marker.

lines.zh: 你站到了我视线的正中。
lines.en: You're dead center in my gaze.

lines.zh: 我没有转头，也不需要。
lines.en: I didn't turn my head. No need.

lines.zh: 这间屋子里，你只有一个出口。
lines.en: This room has one exit for you.

lines.zh: 我在等灯再闪一次。
lines.en: I'm waiting for the light to flicker again.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道变了。
lines.en: Your smell has changed.

lines.zh: 这么久，第一次有人看我。
lines.en: First time in ages anyone looked at me.

lines.zh: 我不会追你，你自己会回来。
lines.en: I won't chase you. You'll come back.

lines.zh: 你手边那个东西，我看见了。
lines.en: That thing by your hand. I saw it.

lines.zh: 我坐得很稳，可以等很久。
lines.en: I'm sitting comfortably. I can wait long.

lines.zh: 你挪到窗边了，那里更暗。
lines.en: You've moved to the window. Darker there.

lines.zh: 我的嘴角又翘起来一点。
lines.en: The corner of my mouth lifts a touch more.

lines.zh: 这屋里的钟停过，我没停。
lines.en: The clock here stopped once. I didn't.

lines.zh: 你从左边走到右边，我一直看着。
lines.en: You went left to right, and I watched.

lines.zh: 我坐在这里，比你想的持久。
lines.en: I sit here longer than you'd think.

lines.zh: 你的脚步在这块地板上很响。
lines.en: Your steps are loud on this floor.

lines.zh: 我不用跟，你绕着屋子转。
lines.en: I needn't follow. You circle the room.

lines.zh: 你的影子又回到我这边了。
lines.en: Your shadow has come back to me.

lines.zh: 我数着你走了多少圈。
lines.en: I count your laps.

lines.zh: 那张桌子上有灯，你不敢碰。
lines.en: There's a lamp on that table. You don't dare.

lines.zh: 我的视线一直没偏。
lines.en: My gaze hasn't drifted once.

lines.zh: 你停下来，是因为累了。
lines.en: You stopped because you're tired.

lines.zh: 你的手在摸门，不在了。
lines.en: Your hand felt for the door. It's gone.

lines.zh: 我坐得越久，越像活物。
lines.en: The longer I sit, the more alive I look.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸在这里有回声。
lines.en: Your breathing has an echo here.

lines.zh: 我再等一等，你就会过来。
lines.en: A little more waiting, and you'll come over.

lines.zh: 这间屋子里，我最有耐心。
lines.en: In this house, I have the most patience.

lines.zh: 你抬了三次脚，都没走。
lines.en: You lifted a foot three times. You stayed.

lines.zh: 我的头朝着门，你出不去。
lines.en: My head faces the door. You won't leave.

lines.zh: 你把手电关了，太迟了。
lines.en: You switched the torch off. Too late.

lines.zh: 我坐在这里，一直数到你。
lines.en: I sit here, and I've counted to you.

lines.zh: 我动不了，这一下是别人替我的。
lines.en: I can't move. That strike came from elsewhere.

lines.zh: 我们的距离，只有你迈出的那一步。
lines.en: The distance between us is only your one step.

lines.zh: 你撞到我的膝盖上了，很硬。
lines.en: You hit my knee. It's hard.

lines.zh: 我的头撞在你的手背上。
lines.en: My head catches the back of your hand.

lines.zh: 我坐着不倒，也不退。
lines.en: I stay seated. I don't fall or yield.

lines.zh: 你被我的姿势绊了一下。
lines.en: My pose tripped you.

lines.zh: 我的缝口拉开了一点，卡住你的袖子。
lines.en: A seam opened a little and caught your sleeve.

lines.zh: 这些东西，不是我在动。
lines.en: It isn't me doing the moving.

lines.zh: 你别指望我会站起来。
lines.en: Don't expect me to stand.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，你就慌了。
lines.en: I don't move, and it rattles you.

lines.zh: 你的手拍在我脸上，很响。
lines.en: Your hand smacks my face, loud.

lines.zh: 我歪向你那边，倒不下来。
lines.en: I tip toward you and don't fall over.

lines.zh: 坐在这里，也能让人退后。
lines.en: Sitting still can make a person back off.

lines.zh: 绒毛被我蹭掉了一片。
lines.en: A patch of fluff rubbed off on you.

lines.zh: 你退了两步，又向前一步。
lines.en: You back two steps and take one forward.

lines.zh: 我没什么能做的，就这样看着。
lines.en: There's little I can do but watch.

lines.zh: 有人把我摆在这张椅子上。
lines.en: Someone set me on this chair.

lines.zh: 我一直在这里，你们没注意。
lines.en: I was here all along. You didn't notice.

lines.zh: 有人擦过这把椅子，没擦我。
lines.en: Someone wiped this chair and left me dusty.

lines.zh: 这屋子的灰尘先认了我。
lines.en: The dust took to me first.

lines.zh: 灯照到我时，我正好朝门。
lines.en: When the light found me, I happened to face the door.

lines.zh: 我从一楼被搬到了这里。
lines.en: I was carried down here from upstairs.

lines.zh: 这间屋子重新开门那天，我就在。
lines.en: I was here the day this room reopened.

lines.zh: 坐久了，我都忘了原来的姿势。
lines.en: Sitting so long, I've forgotten my original pose.

lines.zh: 我的影子被钉在了地板上。
lines.en: My shadow is nailed to the floor.

lines.zh: 有人擦过我，没擦干净。
lines.en: Someone wiped me down. Not thoroughly.

lines.zh: 我身上落着一层新的灰。
lines.en: A fresh layer of dust is on me.

lines.zh: 门开了，我这边的灯没亮。
lines.en: The door opened. The lamp on my side stayed dark.

lines.zh: 我坐在通道边上，正好挡视线。
lines.en: I sit by the passage, catching the eye.

lines.zh: 从门口看进来，最先看到我。
lines.en: From the door, I'm the first thing you see.

lines.zh: 这张椅子的位置，是特意摆的。
lines.en: This chair's spot was chosen on purpose.

lines.zh: 我搁在这儿，算是个提醒。
lines.en: I'm left here as a reminder.

lines.zh: 摆件的命，就是一直摆着。
lines.en: An ornament's fate is to stay put.

lines.zh: 你们进来的时候，我笑了。
lines.en: You came in, and I was smiling.

lines.zh: 火光靠近，我的绒毛先焦了。
lines.en: Fire draws near; my fluff scorches first.

lines.zh: 我被撞下椅子，摔得姿势全乱。
lines.en: I'm knocked off the chair and my pose collapses.

lines.zh: 水渗进来，棉花慢慢沉。
lines.en: Water soaks in and the cotton sinks.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我推离了椅子，落在地上。
lines.en: The blast pushes me off the chair onto the floor.

lines.zh: 有东西插进我的胸口，拔不出来。
lines.en: Something sticks in my chest and won't come out.

lines.zh: 我的身体里没东西可碰，它扑空了。
lines.en: There's nothing inside me to touch; it found none.

lines.zh: 我不用吃饭，坐着就好。
lines.en: I don't need food. Sitting is enough.

lines.zh: 电击穿我，我的绒毛全竖起来。
lines.en: A shock runs through me and my plush bristles.

lines.zh: 椅子没了，我一直往下落。
lines.en: The chair's gone, and I fall on and on.
